title: Model, data and figures for: Small modular reactors and offshore wind for seaweed fuel, food and electric freight in France
description: Monthly screening model of six French coastal hubs combining small modular reactors, offshore wind with turbine-anchored kelp farms, co-located fish, a renewable-powered harvester and utility drones: kelp drop-in fuel cost under three power-supply options, an MED heat cascade compared with heat pumps and reverse osmosis on consolidated accounts with firm heat, co-products, national electric motorways with the transport CO2 they avoid, the national cost-minimising split between electrification and liquid fuels for transport including international aviation and shipping, levers on the price of renewable liquid fuel, RFNBO versus low-carbon e-fuel, and a 2027-2041 transition. Includes model code, 720 consistency tests, hourly ERA5 wind and solar inputs (CC BY 4.0), Monte Carlo draws, all outputs as CSV/JSON and figure scripts. Seaweed cost, anchor sharing, wind prices, drone performance, sea temperatures and the outage schedule are screening inputs.
notes: Licences: the record (data, figures, text) is CC BY 4.0; all code files (Code/model, Code/build) are MIT-licensed as stated in LICENSE.
